description: Compiled JavaScript code for FooTable v3 plugin, specifically implementing sorting functionality including classes, methods, and event handling for table sorting features.

classes.name: F.Sorter
classes.description: Represents a sorting instruction with a specific column and direction.

classes.name: F.Sorting
classes.description: Component that adds sorting UI and logic to FooTable, managing sorting state, UI updates, and event handling.

methods.name: F.Sorting.sort
methods.description: Sets the sorting options and triggers table redraw to sort by specified column and direction.

methods.name: F.Sorting.toggleAllowed
methods.description: Enables or disables the ability to sort the table.

methods.name: F.Sorting.hasChanged
methods.description: Checks if the sorting state has changed from the initial state.

methods.name: F.Sorting.reset
methods.description: Resets the table sorting to the initial state.

methods.name: _sort
methods.description: Performs sorting logic, raising events before and after sorting.

methods.name: _onSortClicked
methods.description: Handles click events on sortable column headers to trigger sorting.
